# Maintained example const headers

This bounded [Issue #33](https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/issues/33) migration
changes ten parameter headers in six maintained example files. Only the
`static` header marker becomes `const`; names, kinds, arguments, bodies,
capabilities, effects, complete phase and owner/product contracts are unchanged.

[Preparation](preparation.json) binds original source bytes to exact Git commit
3e3128c6153df40eb8c6f8fbffeb6bce35a6085a and records desired hashes. Complete
desired projects were saved before any observation or active source edit.
Original projects and earlier authoring snapshots remain in Git/their frozen
locations; this record does not rewrite or automatically migrate them.

[Before selection](before-selection.json) retains sixteen actual CLI calls:
check/run for four complete original projects and four desired projects. Their
run distributions agree exactly on the recorded compiler/kernel. Independent
phase/reference/Grover/protocol oracles are separate integration validation;
matching distributions alone are not general source preservation or proof.
The existing `iterative_qpe` (five tests) and `qli_corpus` (fourteen tests)
integration targets passed on Rust 1.98.1 and the pinned Rust 1.85 MSRV after
the active edits. They independently exercise off-grid branch tomography,
entangled references, complete operator phase and type-correct faulty providers.
An initial command named the nonexistent `measured_qpe` target and exited
before executing tests; the two actual targets were then run without a filter.
No generic QFT, new capacity, native rule, dependency or guarantee is introduced.
Legacy retirement and other #33 clients/builders remain unfinished.
